assessment: Static review completed with unresolved third-party rights and runtime risks. Not a legal clearance or a security certification.

scope.scope_boundary: Selected source, docs, configs, tests and assets only; not a complete training, dataset or model distribution. Generated caches are not part of this 212-file selection.
scope.method: Read-only text and source inspection; file/Git-mode checks; Git blob verification; targeted secret patterns. No upstream imports, installation, build, training, model/API call or remote write was executed by this audit.

intentional_modifications.change: Removed exactly three opaque sealed_token parameters from remote Star History image URLs. All other bytes match upstream.

license_and_permission_observations.permission_basis: Publisher reports separately obtained upstream-author permission. Its text, ownership coverage and evidence were not independently examined in this review.
license_and_permission_observations.boundary: Public hosting, dependency locks, embedded-source declarations and citations are not treated as a verified blanket grant for third-party code, data, models, images or outputs. No LICENSE was added and no third-party content was relicensed.

third_party_sources.status: Runtime, tests, templates and static assets retained; compressed product data excluded. Provenance declaration retained; independent rights/history verification not performed.

third_party_sources.component: WebShop source markers and Bootsnipp-referenced HTML
third_party_sources.status: Source markers exist; full derivation and separate terms are unverified.

third_party_sources.component: Bootstrap, Font Awesome and jQuery CDN resources
third_party_sources.status: External jsdelivr/Google CSS and JavaScript, not vendored distributions; license and payload integrity not audited.
References and patch retained; not an offline bundle or reviewed dependency-license inventory.

references: TRACE paper and alphaXiv bounded reproduction
third_party_sources.status: Citations/acknowledgements preserved. External source ownership, copying boundaries and terms were not independently investigated.

All five image blobs hash-verified. Adjacent paper links/report context are not image-specific provenance or permission. Authorship, reproduction rights, embedded examples and metadata remain unverified by this audit.

resolved_finding.status: Removed and exact limited transform verified. Value not reproduced; capability not tested.

sensitive_information.limitations: Pattern checks do not prove absence. Binary image content/metadata, Git history, credentials, runtime output, remote services and excluded data were not part of the text screen.

execution_and_network_risks.observation: Explicit setup installs packages, expands excluded product data, builds an index and alters installed veRL. Do not run automatically for publication review.
Model loaders enable trust_remote_code; loading/serving can download artifacts and consume GPU resources. Model code, weights and terms are outside scope.

Collection/evaluation and tokenizer helpers can send messages/text and bearer credentials to configured endpoints. One helper defaults to api.openai.com without an explicit base URL. No call was made by this audit.
SwanLab is opt-in; enabled modes can transmit online telemetry. SFT enabled-mode default is online.
Explicit server entry points bind 0.0.0.0; inspected simulator API routes show no authentication. Restrict to loopback or an isolated network before a separately authorized run.
Rendering docs/templates can request remote badges, charts, avatars, CDN and product images. CDN JavaScript executes in a browser; this is not an offline-only reference.
Some simulator imports configure file logging; importing all source modules is not a side-effect-free audit method.

structural_checks.build_system: setuptools.build_meta; no tracked custom setup.py/build hook found
structural_checks.interpretation: No tracked CI/hook path found that automatically launches training on publication. This does not certify scripts, dependencies or model payloads as safe.

unverified_and_recommended_exclusions: Keep all 12 listed raw data/trajectory/parquet/catalog/duplicate-report files excluded unless separately reviewed and authorized.
Keep model weights, checkpoints, adapters, raw observations/responses/logs, caches, virtual environments, credentials and unreviewed Git history excluded.
Resolve embedded ShopSimulator/WebShop, snippet/template, figure and dependency rights separately; preserve attribution and do not imply blanket relicensing.

Retained metadata, task-ID manifests, aggregate reports, test/documentation examples and citations remain upstream/derived content. Raw-dataset exclusion does not establish that every document is free of derived material.
Historical or future-looking docs and performance summaries are not newly reproduced results or a verified complete record of weights/logs/training.
Re-run publication checks after changes. External URL targets, dependency/model payloads and deployment security remain outside this snapshot.
